department: Department of Mathematics and Statistics, Mathematical Institute (Faculty of Science)

deadline.value: Doctoral applications at the University of Bern are accepted throughout the year once a thesis supervisor agrees (fall semester registration runs September 1 to October 15).
deadline.quote: You can apply to do a doctorate throughout the year.

gre_subject.value: The mathematics page does not mention a GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: A confirmed supervisor at Bern must be in place before admission; the confirmation of supervision is filled in for every doctorate.
supervisor.quote: Fill in the confirmation of supervision that applies to your doctorate.

funding.value: Funding is the supervisor's responsibility; the page states no guaranteed funding.
funding.quote: Potential funding of a PhD project is the responsibility of the corresponding supervisor

entry_route.value: A master's or equivalent degree in mathematics or statistics with good or excellent grades is required.
entry_route.quote: a Master's or equivalent degree in Mathematics or Statistics with good or excellent grade is required

also.quote: There are different admission requirements for applicants with a Swiss degree and applicants with an international degree
